description: List the standing rules this project is held to: the workspace library rules it has attached. Read these before writing checks, interview guides or design feedback for the project, and assert them as observable checks rather than restating them. `attachment_id` is this project's copy of the rule; `id` is the library rule shared with every other project holding it.

include_disabled.description: Include attached rules that are switched off, either in the library or for this project. Defaults to false, which returns only rules in force.

name: list_project_guidelines

attachment_enabled.description: This project's own switch, set with set_project_guideline.

attachment_id.description: This project's attachment row id for the rule.

enabled.description: Whether the rule is in force here: true only when both the library and this project have it switched on.

id.description: Library guideline UUID, shared with every project holding it.

source.description: Where the rule came from: manual, generated or imported.

title: List project guidelines
